audit.whatIsWrong: The two ability names are SWAPPED throughout the content layer. The turrets are called 'CH-2 Electron turrets' and the grenade is called 'the H-28G grenade' — it is the reverse: H-28 G Evolution Turret is the Q turret, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is the E stun. wants.foe[1] compounds it into one string, 'the H-28G Evolution Turret grenade (E) stun'. The full layer also wrote 'Beartrap' and never gave a cooldown number.
audit.why: Riot's Q text lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret; Riot's E text lobs a grenade that stuns anyone directly hit and slows around it. Q is a 1s cooldown (turret placement, capped by stored charges), E is a flat 11s and is the button that cancels your E dash or R charge.
audit.corrected: Every swapped name corrected in whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1]; the 11s grenade and the turret's 1s placement written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5] and phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with both the packet chart and the paragraph directly beneath them: Level 1 read Heimerdinger while whys[0] says he can't punish yet, Level 2 read Heimerdinger while whys[1] opens 'Even', Levels 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] says he out-zones you entirely, Level 6 read Heimerdinger while whys[4] calls it your engage window, and 2+ items read Heimerdinger while whys[6] says you keep the edge.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Kled / Skill / Kled, and the mirror already flipped rows 0 and 6 to Kled on both layers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs onto the packet chart with ratings moved, and the three generic phases whys that now contradicted their sides rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty advice was 'track CH-2 Grenade, engage on its cooldown' with no number and no statement of what it actually does to you.
audit.why: The grenade is what turns your committal tools off: Kled's E is a dash and his R is a charge, and a stun landing on either strands you inside a turret nest. That, not the poke, is why the lane is hard.
audit.corrected: The 11s number and the dash/charge cancel written into the cooldown block, the do's and report[5]; the turret nest given its own line as the thing to clear rather than fight through.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early, mid and late were written in the first person.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person at the same length, with the swapped ability names fixed in the same pass.

edits.before: This stays a knife-edge into items rather than a true scaling loss. My Eclipse/Trinity first-item spike with the percent-HP Q can still blow him up if I land R into him, but he just rebuilds turrets behind the wave and pokes from safety, so neither of us runs away with the lane — it's an even fight that hinges on whether I catch him off his nest. Past two items I keep the edge in any side skirmish because my R engage and remount let me reach him through the turrets where a pure poke mage can't peel me forever, but in a straight 5v5 his turret wall and AoE zone matter more than my single-target dive. Close the angles I get and don't facecheck his nest blind.

notes: The headline error here is a straight name swap of the two most-referenced abilities: the page called the turrets CH-2 and the grenade H-28G, which is exactly backwards, and wants.foe[1] fused them into 'the H-28G Evolution Turret grenade (E)'. The packet flagged 'Your Violent Tendencies' as a suspect name — that is a FALSE POSITIVE, it is Kled's own W correctly named with a possessive in front. UPGRADE!!! has range '1' in the kit data because it is a self-buff on his next spell, not a targeted ability; nothing on the page should describe it as a cast at you.
